faq.q: Is December a good time for a Sotogrande yacht charter?
faq.a: Yes. December in Sotogrande offers mild winter sun (12-18°C) and calm seas. It is ideal for a festive Christmas cruise, with fewer crowds and lower rates than summer. Bring a jacket for the breeze.

faq.q: How long does it take to sail from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande?
faq.a: The distance is about 30 nautical miles. On a motor yacht like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (cruising at 22 knots), expect a 1.5-hour trip. Slower boats like the Lagoon 380 catamaran may take 2.5 hours.

faq.q: Can I decorate the boat for Christmas?
faq.a: Yes. We can arrange festive decorations, including a small tree, garlands, and table settings, at no extra cost. Just let us know when you book via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

faq.q: Which boats can I charter in December?
faq.a: All our fleet is available year-round. For a Christmas party, popular choices are the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). Tier A boats start at €749 for 2 hours.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. In case of adverse conditions (strong winds or heavy rain), we can reschedule or cancel with a full refund. December generally offers stable weather.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food?
faq.a: Yes, you can bring your own catering. Many clients order from local Sotogrande restaurants. We provide a cooler and serving areas. The included snacks are light; plan a proper meal for longer charters.

faq.q: How do I book a Sotogrande yacht charter for Christmas 2043?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp. Provide your preferred date, group size, and duration. We will confirm availability and send a booking link. Early booking is recommended for 24-26 December.

data.body_html:
Dreaming of a Christmas on the Costa del Sol? A Sotogrande yacht charter in December 2043 offers a unique way to celebrate the holidays — sunny skies, calm seas, and the glamour of Spain’s most exclusive marina. Depart from Puerto Banús and cruise to Sotogrande in under two hours, with festive drinks, snacks, and a licensed skipper included. Whether you want a short sunset cruise or a full-day Christmas party, our fleet has the perfect boat for your group.

December Weather in Sotogrande: What to Expect

December on the Costa del Sol is mild and pleasant. Average air temperatures range from 12°C to 18°C, with sea temperatures around 16°C. Rain is possible but infrequent — typically 5-6 wet days per month. Sunshine hours average 6 per day, so bring sunglasses and a light jacket for the breeze. The sea state is usually calm, making for comfortable cruising. For the most accurate forecast, check the Boat Rental Marbella weather page before your trip.

Christmas Itineraries from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande

Your charter begins at Puerto Banús, Marbella. From there, a 30-nautical-mile cruise east takes you past the Golden Mile, Cabopino, and the dunes of Artola before reaching Sotogrande. The journey takes about 1.5 hours on a motor yacht like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax). Once in Sotogrande, enjoy the marina’s Christmas lights, dine at a waterfront restaurant, or drop anchor in the bay for a swim (water temperature permitting). Return at sunset for a magical finish.

Our Fleet for December Charters

All our boats are available for Christmas charters. For a festive party, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offers spacious saloons and a flybridge. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski — fun even in December. Budget-friendly options like the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) start at €749 for 2 hours. See the full fleet on our boat rental page.

Festive Extras: Christmas Decorations & Catering

Make your charter truly special with optional Christmas decorations. We can arrange a small tree, tinsel, and festive table settings at no extra cost. For catering, you are welcome to bring your own food. Many clients pre-order from Sotogrande’s top restaurants, or we can recommend local caterers. The included drinks (cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks) are perfect for a Christmas toast.

Why Choose a Sotogrande Yacht Charter in December?

December offers a quieter, more intimate experience than summer. The marinas are less crowded, and the winter light is stunning. A Sotogrande yacht charter in December 2043 is ideal for family gatherings, corporate Christmas parties, or a romantic escape. With all-inclusive pricing — no surprise fees for fuel, skipper, or IVA — you can relax and enjoy the holiday. Book via WhatsApp for the best rates on 24-26 December.

How to Book

Ready to reserve your Christmas charter? Contact us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and duration. We will confirm availability and send a booking link. Early booking is recommended for Christmas week. For more ideas, browse our Marbella boat rental guide.
